main_text.p: Πενταπόλεως Τεῖπολις διέχει ὁδῷ ἡμε- ρῶν εἴκοσιν.
καταισεραπεδλυσων ἀλλήλων ἀπὸ σει- λίων τριῶν.
main_text.head: IV.
main_text.p: II.Ad quæstionem ποῖ, Quorsum, re- spondetur per Accusativum: idque vel sine, vel cum Præpositione εἰς. ut:

p.i: ἵκοντο νῆας πεχ Ε' Αληπαρ ονταν.

main_text.p: III.[Observatio. Vsurpatur etiam Genitivus & Dativus, cum Præpositione ἐπί. ut:
main_text.head: V.
main_text.p: II.Ad quæstionem πόσον χρόνον, Quamdiu, per Accusativum respondetur: idque vel sine, vel cum Præpositione. ut:

p.i: ἐπὶ ἴνας ἡμέρας ἦν χίαν εἶχον.

main_text.p: III.[Observatio. Interdum etiam per Genitivum, aut Dativum, respondetur, ut:

p.i: πέντε ὅλων ἐτέων λαλεῖν μηδὲν ἐξῆν.

page.notes: Greek text is only partly legible on this scan; several words, the Greek accents and breathings are uncertain and may not be exact. Right-hand edge is cut off. The marginal numerals are placed as best read. The small mark at lower right ("ἐν") is a catchword-like fragment and is uncertain.
